mapper.sql: id, user_id, content, options_json, answer, steps_json, knowledge_points_json, confidence, warnings_json, model, favorite, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO photo_search_record (user_id, content, options_json, answer, steps_json, knowledge_points_json, confidence, warnings_json, model) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, #{optionsJson}, #{answer}, #{stepsJson}, #{knowledgePointsJson}, #{confidence}, #{warningsJson}, #{model})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM photo_search_record WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
